text: What? No, it wasn’t about you. It was just some video we saw online, that’s all. Don’t get so worked up about it.

Come on, man. I’m not stupid. You told it right after I walked past, and everyone at your table looked at me and started laughing. If you’ve got something to say, just be straight with me. I can take a joke, but don’t act like I’m invisible.

Honestly, you’re reading way too much into it. We were laughing about the video, not you. If you want to think everything’s about you, that’s your problem, not mine. I don’t have time to tiptoe around every missed chance in the club.

Sure, blame me for noticing when people act like idiots. If you want to laugh at my expense, fine, but at least own it. Don’t try to gaslight me with this “it’s a video” nonsense. You don’t have to tiptoe, just don’t be a coward about it.

You’re really pushing this. I told you how it was, and if you don’t believe me, that’s on you. I’m not here to babysit your ego. If you want to keep imagining insults, go ahead, but don’t expect me to play along.

Save the lecture, Lukas. I don’t need you to babysit anything. Just admit you thought it was funny to take a shot at me in front of your friends. Next time you want to talk about me, do it to my face. Or is that too much for you?
